finding.summary: Five timeout overloads allocate and schedule a new CTS timer for each JS operation.
finding.explanation: The timeout overloads for invocation, constructor invocation, property reads, and property writes each create a CancellationTokenSource(timeout). Every finite-timeout call therefore allocates a CTS and schedules a one-shot timer. This is a source-supported timer-pressure shape, but classification is likely because call rate and whether callers treat each invocation as the intended outer timeout boundary are not visible in this file.
finding.snippet: using var cancellationTokenSource = timeout == Timeout.InfiniteTimeSpan ? null : new CancellationTokenSource(timeout);
